questions.stem:
14. The slant height and the curved surface area of the solid metal right circular cone \(X\) are \(85\text{ cm}\) and \(3060\pi\text{ cm}^2\) respectively.

(a) Find the volume of \(X\) in terms of \(\pi\).

(b) \(X\) is melted and recast into two similar solid right circular cones \(Y\) and \(Z\). The ratio of the base area of \(Y\) to the base area of \(Z\) is \(16:25\).

(i) Find the volume of \(Z\) in terms of \(\pi\).
(ii) It is found that the total surface area of \(Z\) is \(3025\pi\text{ cm}^2\). Are \(X\) and \(Z\) similar? Explain your answer.
(9 marks)
questions.stemZh:
14. 實心金屬直立圓錐 \(X\) 的斜高及曲面面積分別為 \(85\) cm 及 \(3060\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。

(a) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(X\) 的體積。

(b) 將 \(X\) 熔化重鑄成兩個相似的實心直立圓錐 \(Y\) 及 \(Z\)。\(Y\) 與 \(Z\) 的底面積比為 \(16:25\)。

(i) 以 \(\pi\) 求 \(Z\) 的體積。
(ii) 量得 \(Z\) 的總表面積為 \(3025\pi\text{ cm}^2\)。\(X\) 與 \(Z\) 是否相似？試解釋你的答案。
（9 分）
questions.hint: Cone: V = (1/3)πr²h, slant height l = √(r²+h²). Frustum = big cone − small cone, use similarity.
questions.hintZh:
圓錐：體積 \(\frac{1}{3}\pi r^2 h\)，斜高 \(l=\sqrt{r^2+h^2}\)。
重鑄前後體積不變。
相似立體：面積比 \(k^2\)，體積比 \(k^3\)。
questions.solution: 14. (a) Let \(r\text{ cm}\) be the base radius of \(X\). Since the curved surface area is \(\pi r l\), \[\pi r(85)=3060\pi.\] Thus \[ r=36. \] The height of \(X\) is \[\sqrt{85^2-36^2}=77.\] Therefore, the volume of \(X\) is \[\frac13\pi(36)^2(77)=33264\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] (b)(i) Since the base area ratio of \(Y\) to \(Z\) is \(16:25\), their linear ratio is \(4:5\). Hence \(\frac{\text{volume of }Y}{\text{volume of }Z}=\left(\frac45\right)^3=\frac{64}{125}.\) Let the volume of \(Z\) be \(V\). Then the volume of \(Y\) is \(\frac{64}{125}V\), so \(V+\frac{64}{125}V=33264\pi.\) Thus \(\frac{189}{125}V=33264\pi,\) and \(V=22000\pi.\) Therefore, the volume of \(Z\) is \(22000\pi\text{ cm}^3\). (b)(ii) If \(X\) and \(Z\) were similar, then \(\frac{\text{volume of }X}{\text{volume of }Z} =\left(\frac{\text{total surface area of }X}{\text{total surface area of }Z}\right)^{3/2}.\) The total surface area of \(X\) is \(3060\pi+\pi(36)^2=4356\pi.\) Now \(\frac{\text{volume of }X}{\text{volume of }Z} =\frac{33264}{22000}=\frac{189}{125},\) but \(\left(\frac{4356\pi}{3025\pi}\right)^{3/2} =\left(\frac{36}{25}\right)^{3/2} =\left(\frac65\right)^3 =\frac{216}{125}.\) These are not equal. Therefore, \(X\) and \(Z\) are not similar.

(a) Express, in terms of \(\pi\), the total surface area of \(P\). (b) Another solid right circular cone is divided into a frustum \(R\) and a right circular cone \(S\) by a plane which is parallel to its base. The height and the volume of \(R\) are 7 cm and \(7350 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\) respectively. Are \(P\) and \(R\) similar? Explain your answer. (a) Let \(r \mathrm{~cm}\) be the base radius of \(Q\). Height of \(Q=(40-16) \mathrm{cm}=24 \mathrm{~cm}\) \(\frac{\text { Base radius of } Q}{\text { Base radius of the original circular cone }}=\frac{\text { height of } Q}{\text { height of the original circular cone }}\) \(\frac{r}{75} =\frac{24}{40} \\ r =45\) Curved surface area of \(P\) \[=\left[\pi(75) \sqrt{40^{2}+75^{2}}-\pi(45) \sqrt{24^{2}+45^{2}}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\] \[=4080 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] Total surface area of \(P\) \[=\left[4080 \pi+\pi(45)^{2}+\pi(75)^{2}\right] \mathrm{cm}^{2}\] \[=11730 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{2}\] (b) Volume of \(P\) \[=\left[\frac{1}{3} \pi(75)^{2}(40)-\frac{1}{3} \pi(45)^{2}(24)\right] \mathrm{cm}^{3}\] \[=58800 \pi \mathrm{~cm}^{3}\] \[\left(\frac{\text { Height of } P}{\text { Height of } R}\right)^{3}=\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^{3}=\frac{4096}{343}\] \[\frac{\text { Volume of } P}{\text { Volume of } R}=\frac{58800 \pi}{7350 \pi}=8\] \[\because \left(\frac{\text { Height of } P}{\text { Height of } R}\right)^{3} \neq \frac{\text { volume of } P}{\text { volume of } R}\] \(\therefore P\) and \(R\) are not similar.

questions.solution: 13. (a) The height of cone \(Q\) is \[40-16=24\text{ cm}.\] Let the base radius of \(Q\) be \(r\) cm. By similarity, \[\frac{r}{75}=\frac{24}{40},\] so \[ r=45. \] The slant height of the original cone is \[\sqrt{75^2+40^2}=85.\] The slant height of cone \(Q\) is \[\sqrt{45^2+24^2}=51.\] Therefore, the slant height of frustum \(P\) is \[85-51=34.\] The curved surface area of \(P\) is \[\pi(75+45)(34)=4080\pi.\] Hence the total surface area of \(P\) is \[4080\pi+\pi(75)^2+\pi(45)^2\] \[=4080\pi+5625\pi+2025\pi =11730\pi\text{ cm}^2.\] (4 marks) (b) The volume of \(P\) is \[\frac13\pi(75)^2(40)-\frac13\pi(45)^2(24)\] \[=75000\pi-16200\pi =58800\pi\text{ cm}^3.\] If \(P\) and \(R\) are similar, then the ratio of their volumes should be the cube of the ratio of their corresponding heights. However, \[\frac{V_P}{V_R}=\frac{58800\pi}{7350\pi}=8,\] while \[\left(\frac{16}{7}\right)^3=\frac{4096}{343}\ne 8.\] Therefore, \(P\) and \(R\) are not similar. (3 marks)
